<h3>Как исполняется программа</h3><p>Тек:
How the program is executed

The C text is translated into JavaScript and executed in the model. Register accesses go through their descriptions: a field is checked by name and width, and a write to a protected register without EALLOW is not executed, as on the chip. main() runs at t = 0; the ISR runs instantaneously in the clock cycle in which the core accepts the interrupt. The background loop for(;;) is not executed in the model. The lab variable (for example, i_meas, pos_meas) is displayed on a separate oscilloscope trace; another variable can be selected on the «Variables» tab.
<h3>Ограничения</h3><ul><li>Поддерживает:
Limitations

  • A subset of C is supported: variables, arrays, functions, #define macros, type casts, pointers to register structures (volatile struct EPWM_REGS *p). Structure declarations, typedef, pointers to variables and #if are not supported.
  • Assignment to an integer variable truncates the value to the type width (int - 16 bits, as in C28x, long - 32); the ++ and -- operators do not limit the width; float is computed in double precision.
  • Not modelled: ISR execution time, CMPB, HRPWM, phase synchronization of modules, ADC B-D, CLA, DMA, CPU timers and communication interfaces.
<h3>Перенос на кристалл</h3><p>Программа:
Porting to the chip

The program is written for the C2000Ware header files (F2837xD_device.h, F2837xD_Examples.h). Copy the text into a CCS project based on a C2000Ware example, add the files F2837xD_SysCtrl.c, F2837xD_PieCtrl.c, F2837xD_PieVect.c, F2837xD_DefaultISR.c, F2837xD_GlobalVariableDefs.c, F2837xD_CodeStartBranch.asm, F2837xD_usDelay.asm and the corresponding linker command files.

What is modelled

The TMS320F2837xD chip after InitSysCtrl(): SYSCLK = 200 MHz, EPWMCLK = 100 MHz, model step 10 ns. The following are modelled at the register level: modules ePWM1–ePWM3 (counter, compare, action qualifier, dead band, trip zone TZ, digital compare DC, events and ADC trigger), ADC A (SOC0–SOC3, ADCINT1), eQEP1, comparators CMPSS1–CMPSS8 with DACs and digital filters, Input X-BAR and ePWM X-BAR, GPIO multiplexer, PIE interrupt controller (groups 1, 3, 5), core registers IER, IFR, the INTM flag, EALLOW protection, watchdog.
